conclusions.text: The two named JRC 2024 raster tiles use actual native north edges 30°N and 40°N; all 24 streamed source files match their previously retained byte counts and whole-file SHA-256 values. The former inferred edges are displaced by 10°.

All three January control pixel values are present at their exact native row/column, but each formerly claimed center is 10° north of the true pixel center and outside the pinned component; the previous validator false-passed these controls.

Using only the native TIFF footprints, 23 of 70 components intersect the two tile union (22 full footprint, 1 partial) and 47 have no footprint coverage. The erroneous former monthly count and per-family water context are withdrawn; corrected monthly counts are unknown.

The original full 552-block monthly raster phase requires 578,813,952 decoded bytes before other complete-phase inputs and outputs, beyond the 256 MiB cap. No full replacement monthly summary was run, and no tile footprint establishes observations, whole-component water/land, ice, cause, ownership, or historical state.

Adjacent administrative and water-source context remains limited: historical MAPA source bytes, current MAPA geometry reuse terms, APA reuse terms, and MITECO vectors remain unavailable/unresolved; these limitations are retained and are not repaired by the raster correction.

methods.area_method: Transform component polygons and native TIFF footprints from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:6933 with pyproj always_xy and calculate Shapely intersection area; this is not the shared WGS84 land-area helper.
methods.crs: Native TIFF EPSG:4326; equal-area overlay EPSG:6933
methods.description: Verify all 24 complete source hashes and native Rasterio/GDAL geotransforms; read three exact source-pixel controls; intersect all 70 unchanged polygons with true native tile footprints; and compute each covered component’s full 12-month pixel-center counts from authenticated TIFF byte arrays using all intersecting native blocks in one admitted component-year phase. Two fresh runs are byte-identical. This does not classify full territory, area, ownership or historical boundaries.
methods.distance_method: No distance metric; native pixel-center coordinates are checked with exact component point-in-polygon membership.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; Rasterio 1.4.3 / GDAL 3.9.3; Shapely 2.1.2; pyproj 3.7.2; NumPy 2.3.5; Rasterio MemoryFile
methods.units: native coordinates in degrees; footprint fractions in EPSG:6933 square metres; dated monthly pixel centers

methods.description: Stream official JRC assets without duplicate storage, enforce per-file and aggregate caps before body reads, compute SHA-256 and compare to every preserved original.
Resolve all 57 issue contact IDs in exact baseline GeoJSON feature IDs and map to their recorded parent, source role, source year, family and component memberships.
